simple.meaning: חוֹל (chôwl) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “sand (as round or whirling particles).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 23 times across Genesis, Exodus, Deuteronomy, Joshua, Judges, and 10 more, beginning at Genesis 22:17. Its contexts include family, death, mountain, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חוֹל (H2344).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חוֹל (chôwl) / H2344 is traced through Genesis 22:17, Genesis 32:13, Genesis 41:49, Exodus 2:12 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H2344. chol חוֺל noun masculine Hosea 2:1 sand (perhaps as turning or whirling ; otherwise explained by Sta, see below חֲוִילָה ; Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic חָלָא , ) — ׳ח absolute Gen 22:17 15 t.; construct 32:13 6 t.; — sand Exod 2:12 (E); set as bound for sea Jer 5:22 ; ח טמוני ׳שְׂפֻנֵי Deut 33:19 hidden treasures of sand , poetic for glass (regarded as mysteriously produced out of sand, see Di and references); a. usually sand of seashore, simile of numberlessness, vastness, so of Abraham's seed Gen 22:17 (J; compare 15:5 ); Jacob's 32:13 (E) of a host Josh 11:4 (JE), Judg 7:12 ; 1Sam 13:5 ; 2Sam 17:11 ; a people 1Kin 4:20 ; Hosea 2:1 ; Isa 10:22 ; 48:19 (|| כִּמְעֹתָ֑יו מֶעֶיךָ וְצֶאֱצָאֵי ), Jer 33:22 ; Hab 1:9 ; of corn gathered by Joseph Gen 41:49 ; of days of Job Job 29:18 (on interpretation = phoenix , see Di); of birds כנף עוף (i.e. quails) Psa 78:27 (|| כֶּעָפָר ); of vast extent of Solomon's wisdom 1Kin 5:9 . b. in compare, more than the sand Jer 15:8 (widows of Judah); thoughts of God Psa 139:18 . c. of weight (in balances), metaphor of Job's vexation ( כַּעַשׂ ) Job 6:3 heavier than the sand, compare הַחוֺל וְנֵטֶל Prov 27:3 (|| אֶבֶן כֹּבֶד ), said of אֱוִיל כַּעַס . — Combinations are: הים שׂפת על אשׁר ׳כח Gen 22:17 ; Josh 11:4 ; 1Sam 13:5 ; 1Kin 5:9 ; ׳כח הַיָּם Gen 32:13 ; 41:49 ; Isa 10:22 ; Hosea 2:1 (+ יִסָּפֵר ולא יִמַּד לא אשׁר ); ׳ח הַיָּם Jer 33:22 ; ׳כח לרב הים שֶׁעַלשֿׂפת Judg 7:12 ; ׳כח לרב אשׁרעֿלהֿים 2Sam 17:11 ; 1Kin 4:20 ; יַמִּים (מ)חול Job 6:3 ; Psa 78:27 ; Jer 15:8 .
